releases.name: Version 0.7.0
releases.description:
# GamesAI v0.7.0

---

**Welcome to GamesAI v0.7.0!** This update brings a new conversation experience, two handy new commands, and smoother debugging.

**What's new:**
- 🆕 **`!!ask switch <模型>`** — switch the AI model of your current conversation at any time and keep chatting.
- ⚡ **`!!ask -f <内容>`** — don't want to wait for the current reply? Your message is now able to join the conversation right away (alias: `-forced`).
- 🧹 **Removed commands** — the old `!!ask -m <模型>` / `--model` variants have been removed; everything they could do is now covered by the new commands above.
- 💬 **Better conversation management** — each player's conversations are now managed independently, so switching models no longer changes others and history stays with you.
- 📋 **Debug logs** — run `!!gamesai debug` to see the full request flow in the console.

> ℹ️ Note: in this version, switching models keeps the conversation history. The final handling policy is being decided by a community vote and will land in v0.7.1 — join the poll: <https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/issues/20>

Enjoy, and thanks for playing GamesAI! 🎮

---

**欢迎使用 GamesAI v0.7.0！** 本次更新带来了全新的对话体验、两个实用新命令,以及更顺畅的调试体验。

**更新内容:**
- 🆕 **`!!ask switch <模型>`** — 随时切换当前对话使用的 AI 模型,聊着天也能换。
- ⚡ **`!!ask -f <内容>`** — 不想等上一个回复?现在你可以直接把问题插入到正在进行的对话中(别名为 `-forced`)。
- 🧹 **移除旧命令** — 旧的 `!!ask -m <模型>` / `--model` 系列命令已移除,其功能已由上述新命令覆盖。
- 💬 **更好的对话管理** — 每位玩家的对话现在独立管理,互不干扰,切换模型也不会影响他人。
- 📋 **调试日志** — 执行 `!!gamesai debug` 即可在控制台查看完整请求流程。

> ℹ️ 说明:本版本中切换模型会保留对话历史。最终的处理方案正在由社区投票决定,将于 0.7.1 落地 —— 欢迎参与投票:<https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/issues/20>

祝使用愉快,感谢你支持 GamesAI!🎮

---

**歡迎使用 GamesAI v0.7.0！** 本次更新帶來了全新的對話體驗、兩個實用新指令,以及更順暢的除錯體驗。

**更新內容:**
- 🆕 **`!!ask switch <模型>`** — 隨時切換目前對話使用的 AI 模型,聊著天也能換。
- ⚡ **`!!ask -f <內容>`** — 不想等上一個回覆?現在你可以直接把問題插入到進行中的對話裡(別名為 `-forced`)。
- 🧹 **移除舊指令** — 舊的 `!!ask -m <模型>` / `--model` 系列指令已移除,其功能已由上述新指令涵蓋。
- 💬 **更好的對話管理** — 每位玩家的對話現在獨立管理,互不干擾,切換模型也不會影響他人。
- 📋 **除錯日誌** — 執行 `!!gamesai debug` 即可在主控台查看完整請求流程。

> ℹ️ 說明:本版本中切換模型會保留對話歷史。最終的處理方案正在由社群投票決定,將於 0.7.1 落地 —— 歡迎參與投票:<https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/issues/20>

祝使用愉快,感謝你支持 GamesAI!🎮

releases.name: Version 0.6.4
releases.description:
# 🎮 GamesAI v0.6.4

## English

### ✨ Highlights

- **🔐 Permission-Based AI Tools** — AI tools can now be restricted by permission level. Players only see (and the AI can only use) the tools they are actually allowed to use, and the limits follow your `permission` config in real time.
- **♻️ Reliable Hot Reload** — `!!gamesai reload` now completely rebuilds the AI tool set: built-in tools, your custom `tools.py`, and tools registered by other plugins all refresh correctly. Custom tools you delete actually disappear after a reload.
- **🧰 Tool Set Adjustments** — Whitelist management tools and Minecraft Wiki search have moved to the [GamesAI-Extra](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI-Extra) plugin; online player queries now fall back to RCON when the `online_player_api` plugin is unavailable.
- **🐛 Fixes** — Fixed permission levels being locked at startup, fixed hot reload silently dropping all built-in tools, and removed leftover code that could crash tool registration.

### 🔧 For Developers

- `@register_tool` now supports a `perm` parameter (a fixed level or a dynamic value that follows the plugin's `permission` setting).
- Plugins that register AI tools are now automatically reloaded together with GamesAI during hot reload — no extra registration needed.

---

## 简体中文

### ✨ 更新亮点

- **🔐 AI 工具权限系统** — AI 工具现在可以按权限等级限制使用。玩家只会看到（AI 也只会调用）自己有权使用的工具，限制实时跟随你的 `permission` 配置。
- **♻️ 更可靠的热重载** — `!!gamesai reload` 现在会完整重建 AI 工具集：内置工具、你的自定义 `tools.py` 以及其他插件注册的工具都能正确刷新，删除的自定义工具在重载后真正消失。
- **🧰 工具集调整** — 白名单管理工具和 Minecraft Wiki 搜索已迁移至 [GamesAI-Extra](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI-Extra) 插件；在线玩家查询在缺少 `online_player_api` 插件时回退为 RCON 查询。
- **🐛 修复** — 修复权限等级启动时被锁死、热重载后内置工具全部丢失、以及可能导致工具注册崩溃的残留代码。

### 🔧 开发者相关

- `@register_tool` 新增 `perm` 参数（可填固定等级，也可动态跟随插件的 `permission` 设置）。
- 注册了 AI 工具的插件现在会随 GamesAI 热重载自动重载，无需额外登记。

---

## 繁體中文

### ✨ 更新亮點

- **🔐 AI 工具權限系統** — AI 工具現在可以按權限等級限制使用。玩家只會看到（AI 也只會呼叫）自己有权使用的工具，限制即時跟隨你的 `permission` 設定。
- **♻️ 更可靠的熱重載** — `!!gamesai reload` 現在會完整重建 AI 工具集：內建工具、你的自訂 `tools.py` 以及其他插件註冊的工具都能正確刷新，刪除的自訂工具在重載後真正消失。
- **🧰 工具集調整** — 白名單管理工具和 Minecraft Wiki 搜尋已遷移至 [GamesAI-Extra](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI-Extra) 插件；線上玩家查詢在缺少 `online_player_api` 插件時回退為 RCON 查詢。
- **🐛 修復** — 修復權限等級啟動時被鎖死、熱重載後內建工具全部遺失、以及可能導致工具註冊崩潰的殘留程式碼。

### 🔧 開發者相關

- `@register_tool` 新增 `perm` 參數（可填固定等級，也可動態跟隨插件的 `permission` 設定）。
- 註冊了 AI 工具的插件現在會隨 GamesAI 熱重載自動重新載入，無需額外登記。

---

🖥️ 安装方式：在 MCDR 控制台执行 `!!MCDR plugin install games_ai` · Install: run `!!MCDR plugin install games_ai` in the MCDR console

releases.name: Version 0.6.3
releases.description:
## English

### GamesAI 0.6.3

**Highlights**

- **🛠️ Automatic Minecraft Version Compatibility** — When your server updates to a newer Minecraft version, the bot no longer gets stuck with "Server version is not supported" errors. The plugin now automatically updates its components and restarts the bot, so it keeps working after every server upgrade.
- **🔒 Safer Bot Control** — Starting or stopping the bot through the AI now requires the configured permission level. Players without permission can no longer control the bot indirectly.
- **🕐 Smarter Startup** — The bot now waits for the Minecraft server to start before connecting, so it launches successfully even when the server isn't ready yet.
- **📦 Clean Shutdown** — When the plugin is unloaded, all extension plugins registered with it are unloaded together, with failure isolation so one issue never blocks the rest.

**What's included**

- Fixed the `Server version 'X' is not supported` error after Minecraft server upgrades — automatic update and restart
- Added permission checks for the AI tools that start/stop the bot
- The bot now waits for the server to start before launching, preventing startup connection failures
- Extension plugins that integrate with GamesAI are now reliably unloaded when the plugin is removed

---

## 简体中文

### GamesAI 0.6.3

**核心亮点**

- **🛠️ 版本兼容自动修复** — 服务器升级到新版 Minecraft 后，机器人不再卡在 "Server version is not supported" 报错上。插件会自动更新组件并重启机器人，每次服务器升级后都能继续正常工作。
- **🔒 更安全的机器人控制** — 通过 AI 启动或停止机器人现在需要达到配置的权限等级，无权限玩家无法再间接操控机器人。
- **🕐 更智能的启动时机** — 机器人会先等待 Minecraft 服务器启动完成再连接，服务器尚未就绪时也能正常启动。
- **📦 干净地卸载** — 插件被卸载时，所有与之集成的扩展插件会一并卸载，且做了失败隔离，单个插件出问题不会影响其余插件。

**更新内容**

- 修复服务器升级后出现 `Server version 'X' is not supported` 报错的问题——自动更新并重启
- 为 AI 启停机器人的工具添加权限校验
- 机器人会等待服务器启动后再连接，避免启动即连接失败
- 与 GamesAI 集成的扩展插件在插件卸载时会被可靠地一并卸载

---

## 繁體中文

### GamesAI 0.6.3

**核心亮點**

- **🛠️ 版本相容自動修復** — 伺服器升級到新版 Minecraft 後，機器人不再卡在 "Server version is not supported" 報錯上。插件會自動更新元件並重啟機器人，每次伺服器升級後都能繼續正常運作。
- **🔒 更安全的機器人控制** — 透過 AI 啟動或停止機器人現在需要達到設定的權限等級，無權限玩家無法再間接操控機器人。
- **🕐 更聰明的啟動時機** — 機器人會先等待 Minecraft 伺服器啟動完成再連線，伺服器尚未就緒時也能正常啟動。
- **📦 乾淨地卸載** — 插件被卸載時，所有與之整合的擴充插件會一併卸載，且做了失敗隔離，單個插件出問題不會影響其餘插件。

**更新內容**

- 修復伺服器升級後出現 `Server version 'X' is not supported` 報錯的問題——自動更新並重啟
- 為 AI 啟停機器人的工具新增權限校驗
- 機器人會等待伺服器啟動後再連線，避免啟動即連線失敗
- 與 GamesAI 整合的擴充插件在插件卸載時會被可靠地一併卸載

## v0.6.1 - Extension Plugin System & Quality Improvements

This update brings deeper integration capabilities for MCDR plugin developers and improves overall stability.

Other MCDR plugins can now seamlessly integrate with GamesAI. Use `register_self()` to have your plugin automatically reloaded when GamesAI reloads, and `register_skills()` to register skill files programmatically — no need to manually edit config files.

### 🛡️ Bot Username Validation
`!!aibot join` now validates the bot username, rejecting invalid characters before attempting to connect.

### 📦 Tools Reorganized
Waypoint and position management tools have been moved to the new **[GamesAI-Extra](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI-Extra)** plugin to keep the core lightweight.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Fixed a bug where some registered plugins could be skipped during reload.
- Improved logging throughout plugin lifecycle events.

修改配置时不再需要担心类型错误——插件会自动识别并匹配。Bot 账号设置也可以通过命令直接完成，无需手动编辑配置文件。

- 盔甲装卸、路径失败检测等多项优化

```bash
!!MCDR plugin install games_ai
```

releases.name: Version 0.5.11
releases.description:
## 🐛 Bug Fix: Tool Execution Race Condition

Fixed a critical bug where using blocking tools (such as setting timers) could cause persistent HTTP 400 errors and conversation history corruption. When a tool blocked the request thread, incomplete tool call records leaked into shared conversation history, causing all subsequent requests to fail until the history was manually cleared. Now each request safely manages its own conversation state, and concurrent requests no longer overwrite each other.

---

## 🐛 Bug 修复：工具执行竞态条件

- Fixed some issues.

releases.description:
中文:
本次更新如下内容:
 - 添加了Python包依赖的说明，以免使用MCDR指令自动安装时出现问题
 - 添加了公共数据库，现在可以通过指令`!!data`实现公有的数据添加

English:

 - Added instructions for Python package dependencies to prevent issues during automatic installation via MCDR commands
 - Added a public database; now public data can be added using the `!!data` command
 - Modified the method for constructing help messages
 - Added the `permission` configuration option to set the required permission level for commands such as `!!data`
